The workshop closes on Tuesday afternoon with a round table on how the community should develop. The agenda set by the organisers covers four themes:

1. Young Speaker Award
2. Developing the community — the emissivity.org website, mailing lists and newsletter, visibility, intercomparisons and round-robin tests, data collection
3. Collaborations — networking, funding (e.g. COST Actions, Horizon Europe), thematic working groups, links with groups worldwide
4. The future of IR-EMPOWER — periodicity, format, venue

The outcomes will be summarised here after the workshop.
